1/5 One of the major dangers of calling external contracts is that they can take over the control flow.

2/5 In the reentrancy attack, a malicious contract calls back into the calling contract before the first invocation finishes.

3/5 This may cause the different invocations of the function to interact in undesirable ways.

4/5 Make sure all internal state changes are performed before the call is executed.

5/5 Use a reentrancy lock (ie. OpenZeppelin's ReentrancyGuard).
Check the return value when using low-level call methods.
